entries.columnsContract: `command_receipt_id PK, owner_domain, command_contract, caller_scope, idempotency_key, request_digest, target_type, target_id, result_schema_ref, result_ref_json, result_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(owner_domain,command_contract,caller_scope,idempotency_key)`；同key不同request digest拒绝；Result JSON上限`16 KiB`且只含typed ref；与Owner修改同事务

entries.columnsContract: `work_id PK, owner_domain, process_type, process_id, work_kind, basis_digest, priority_class, state, idempotency_key, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
`attempt_id PK, work_id FK, ordinal, basis_digest, state, started_at_ms, finished_at_ms, failure_code`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(work_id,ordinal)`；同一Work至多一个`ready|running|blocked` attempt的partial unique index

entries.columnsContract: `plan_id PK, attempt_id FK, planner_ref, planner_version, catalog_digest, basis_digest, graph_digest, state, created_at_ms`

`plan_id FK, node_id, capability_ref, contract_version, input_binding_schema_ref, input_bindings_json, parameter_schema_ref, parameters_json, when_schema_ref, when_json, effect_class, fence_schema_ref, fence_basis_json, resource_demand_schema_ref, resource_demand_json`

entries.constraintsContract: `PK(plan_id,from_node_id,to_node_id)`；两个node均FK到同一Plan；DAG validator digest与Plan同时提交

entries.columnsContract: `event_id PK, plan_id FK, node_id, work_id, attempt_id, owner_domain, capability_ref, contract_version, state, priority_class, ready_at_ms, retry_at_ms, result_id, current_progress_revision`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(plan_id,node_id)`；`INDEX(state,priority_class,COALESCE(retry_at_ms,ready_at_ms),event_id)`；成功Event不可回退；current progress pointer显式FK

entries.columnsContract: `event_attempt_id PK, event_id FK, ordinal, executor_ref, executor_version, input_snapshot_schema_ref, input_snapshot_digest, fence_snapshot_digest, state, outcome_kind, retry_after_ms, failure_class, failure_code, evidence_digest, started_at_ms, finished_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(event_id,ordinal)`；同一Event至多一个`executing` attempt；Permit/lease不持久化，资源等待与持有只由timing Evidence表达；deferred/fence evidence留在Attempt而非伪terminal Result

entries.columnsContract: `event_id FK, event_attempt_id FK, revision, mode, current_value, total_value, unit, rate, eta_ms, source_sequence, progress_bucket, sampled_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(event_id,revision)`；`UNIQUE(event_attempt_id,source_sequence)` when sequence exists；只保留current及有界bucket history；数值必须满足non-negative/finite check
`PK(owner_domain,reconciler_key)`；revision从1递增；opaque cursor为不超过`4 KiB`的bounded string或NULL；只保存Foundation调度位置，不保存或解释Domain Fact；每页Scope全部完成幂等reconcile后才CAS推进，崩溃前未推进时允许整页重放

entries.columnsContract: `result_id PK, event_id FK, outcome_kind, result_schema_ref, result_json, result_digest, evidence_schema_ref, evidence_json, evidence_digest, effect_receipt_id, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: terminal Event至多一个current result：`UNIQUE(event_id)`；两个JSON的UTF-8 JCS bytes各自≤`65,536`，大Payload必须只含typed handle；`result_digest=SHA-256(JCS(result_json解析后的完整typed Result，包含其中所有领域内digest字段))`，领域对象内部排除自身计算的digest不是Foundation storage digest；Field Observation Commit的`evidence_schema_ref`固定为`FieldObservationPage@1`并在`evidence_json`保存完整Page，`result_schema_ref/result_json`固定为完整`ObservationCommitResult@1`

entries.columnsContract: `effect_id PK, event_attempt_id FK, effect_class, idempotency_key, intent_digest, state, external_receipt_ref, output_digest, verified_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
`commit_marker PK, effect_id, owner_domain, scope_type, scope_id, commit_digest, result_id FK, result_schema_ref, result_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `commit_marker`全局唯一；Event驱动的`domain_fact_commit|responsibility_control_commit`其result字段必填并与对应`fx_event_result_bindings`同事务写入；唯一例外是非Event的Procurement Run Admission，其result字段为NULL，完整`ProcurementControlReceipt`由同事务`fx_command_receipts`承载并以marker scope/digest交叉验证；不能更新或删除
